prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop homepage composition probe, 16:10 landscape, showing the complete first viewport plus the beginning of the second fold.
Primary request: Design Composition A for the real Luban youth nonprofit homepage in the already-approved Signal Poster Wall visual world. This is a WEBSITE UI comp, not a poster or scene.
Surface structure in order: a thin sticky navigation row with Luban wordmark and Home / Programs / About / Contact; a first viewport divided by a rigorous 12-column modular grid; left 4 columns hold the medium-weight headline, exact mission paragraph, and two rectangular actions; right 8 columns form a 2-by-2 wall of four program posters for Hands-On Events, Post-Secondary Blueprint, Career Pathfinder, and Mentorship; a narrow baseline strip begins the next fold with the exact facts 4 Core Program Pillars, 18 Current Core Members, 100 National Volunteers by 2028.
Signature interaction framing: one poster is in focus and spans two grid modules while the other three remain readable; thin track marks imply grid-snapped rearrangement, not floating cards.
Real content: headline 'Preparing Youth for University and Careers in Business'. Mission copy begins 'Luban is a youth-led multiprovincial nonprofit dedicated to enriching and preparing high school students, especially those in underserved communities'. Rectangular CTA labels 'Explore Programs' and 'Contact Luban'.
Visual world: uncoated cool poster white #F7F7F2, near-black #151918, signal red #C93A32, civic blue #2459A8, restrained yellow #D7AB2A; flat solid color only, thin black rules, geometric arcs and bars as imagery, subtle paper tooth but no decorative texture.
Typography: approachable Swiss grotesk, medium and regular weights only; headline approximately 54px desktop, never extra-bold or ultra-condensed; body 18px; labels 12-14px. Clear hierarchy without gigantic type.
Controls: squared or 2px corners, 1.5px rules, buttons feel like poster captions with arrows, visible keyboard focus state represented once.
Constraints: same real Luban content and facts; accessible contrast; no fake testimonials, dates, partner logos, or photography; show enough second fold to prove the system continues.
Avoid: gradients, neon, glass, bento SaaS cards, pill buttons, rounded blobs, generic icons, giant bold type, full-bleed photo, excessive shadows, dashboard chrome, making the whole output look like a standalone printed poster.
